_note: RECONSTRUCTED. Response of GET https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/ms/PL/vat/1234567890 for a well-formed but unregistered/invalid number: HTTP 200, isValid=false, userError=INVALID, name/address '---'. IMPORTANT: userError values MS_UNAVAILABLE / SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE / TIMEOUT / GLOBAL_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ / MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ also arrive with HTTP 200 and isValid=false - they mean 'unknown', not 'invalid' (see check-ms-unavailable.json). Treat only userError==='INVALID' as a definitive negative.
